summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Listing Scraper app. All backend APIs (19/19) and frontend flows (16/16) passed successfully. Real Amazon scraping verified with Decodo API integration.

backend_issues.notes: All 19 backend API endpoints tested and working correctly. Minor routing note: /health endpoint returns frontend HTML due to ingress routing; /api/health returns proper JSON.

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/health returns ok
Backend: GET /api/brands lists all brands with counts (asin_count, pincode_count, last_scraped, in_stock_count)
Backend: POST /api/brands creates new brand with default pincode 400064 Mumbai
Backend: POST /api/brands rejects duplicate brand
Backend: DELETE /api/brands/:name removes brand and cascades children
Backend: GET /api/brands/:name returns brand with asins, pincodes, results, job
Backend: POST /api/brands/:name/pincodes adds valid 6-digit pincode
Backend: POST /api/brands/:name/pincodes rejects invalid pincode
Backend: DELETE /api/brands/:name/pincodes/:code removes pincode
Backend: POST /api/brands/:name/asins adds valid 10-char ASIN
Backend: POST /api/brands/:name/asins rejects invalid ASIN
Backend: DELETE /api/brands/:name/asins/:asin removes ASIN
Backend: POST /api/brands/:name/upload replaces ASIN list with added/skipped counts
Backend: GET /api/brands/:name/download returns CSV with UTF-8 BOM and ASIN,Notes columns
Backend: POST /api/brands/:name/scrape starts background job, returns 409 if already scraping
Backend: GET /api/brands/:name/status returns isScraping, progress, logs
Backend: POST /api/scrape-all kicks off scrapes for all brands with pincodes
Backend: GET /api/brands/:name/csv returns CSV with UTF-8 BOM and 14 required columns
Backend: Scrape result populates from Amazon (title, price, seller, rating, reviews, stock, delivery)
Backend: Price formatted as 'Rs. NNN' (integer rupees, no rupee symbol)
Backend: pincode_verified flag is True when delivery text contains requested pincode
Backend: 2000ms delay between scrape calls honored
Frontend: Home page shows topbar with title 'Listing Scraper', subtitle 'TWGE Solutions', green online dot
Frontend: Brand cards grid visible with Add New Brand form
Frontend: Pre-loaded brand 'Chheda' card visible with stats (4 ASINs, 1 pincode)
Frontend: Click brand card opens brand detail screen with stats bar, action buttons
Frontend: Add new brand creates with default pincode 400064 Mumbai and refreshes grid
Frontend: Delete brand button asks confirmation and removes from grid
Frontend: Pincode pills show code + city + remove button
Frontend: Add pincode validates 6-digit format
Frontend: ASIN manager: add ASIN validates 10 chars, remove single, checkboxes, download CSV
Frontend: Scrape This Brand opens pincode selection modal with checkboxes + Select All
Frontend: Pincode selection modal disables confirm if nothing selected, updates button text dynamically
Frontend: After confirming scrape modal, progress card shows progress bar, label with ASIN/pincode info, live logs
Frontend: Results table renders rows with all columns, In Stock=green badge, Verified=Yes/No badge
Frontend: Export Results CSV button triggers download
Frontend: Uses XMLHttpRequest (no fetch) and DOM createElement (no innerHTML for dynamic data)

success_percentage.integration: 100% (scraping, CSV export, real-time progress tracking all working)
